title: qemu vars
description: Variables for QEMU and KVM virtualization component

QEMU_VERSION.description: Version of QEMU to install (default: latest)

QEMU_SETUP_KVM_GROUPS.description: Add current user to kvm and libvirt groups on Linux (1 or 0)

QEMU_SETUP_UEFI_FIRMWARE.description: Create standard edk2/OVMF UEFI firmware symlinks in /usr/local/share/qemu (1 or 0)
